válaszodban szeretném ha csak listába írnád efymás mellé sorolva a dolgokat amiket keresek, minden más nélkül.
entries.answer:
Input Tokenization → Token Embeddings + Positional Encodings (sinusoidal or learned)
 Encoder Stack (N identical layers):
   MultiHead SelfAttention (Q, K, V projections, scaled dotproduct attention, concatenated heads)
   Add & LayerNorm (residual connection + Layer Normalization)
   Positionwise FeedForward Network (2 linear layers with ReLU/GELU activation)
   Add & LayerNorm (residual connection + Layer Normalization)
 Decoder Stack (N identical layers):
   Masked MultiHead SelfAttention (causal masking for autoregressive generation)
   CrossAttention (queries from decoder, keys/values from encoder output)
   Add & LayerNorm (after each attention sublayer)
   Positionwise FeedForward Network (same structure as encoder)
   Add & LayerNorm (after FFN)
 Output Projection → Linear Layer (vocabulary size) → Softmax (probability distribution over tokens)

Architectural Variants:
 Encoderonly (BERT, RoBERTa) — bidirectional understanding, classification/NER/QA
 Decoderonly (GPT, LLaMA) — autoregressive generation, causal attention only
 EncoderDecoder (T5, BART) — sequencetosequence tasks (translation, summarization)
